purpose: Cultural sources discovered publicly but not copied into an open corpus without adequate rights or actual Garhwali content

sources.title: Garhwali Folktales podcast
sources.content: 66 narrated Garhwali folk-story episodes
sources.reason: All 66 enclosures exposed by the official RSS feed were archived locally with hashes and source URLs; the listing names the creator and displays an explicit copyright notice.
sources.next_action: Transcribe locally, retain the rights-pending label, and seek consent and an explicit dataset license before redistribution.

sources.title: Garhwali Lokgeet by Govind Chatak
sources.content: Garhwali folk-song collection with Hindi translations
sources.reason: The repository exposes cover and contents files without a verified open license for the book text.
sources.next_action: Contact the rights holder or locate an authorized open edition.

sources.title: Gadwali Lokgeet by Govind Chatak (1956 Internet Archive scan)
sources.content: Volume 1, Laghu Git: a Garhwali folk-song collection with a downloadable Digital Library of India scan
sources.reason: The PDF, OCR text, DjVu XML and metadata were archived; 370 OCR page records were extracted. Internet Archive metadata supplies neither a rights statement nor an open-content license.
sources.next_action: Clean and language-segment locally while retaining provenance and the rights-pending label.

sources.title: Garhwali folk literature critical study by Mohanlal Babulkar (1964)
sources.content: 307-page critical study of Garhwali folk literature, digitized from the University of Michigan
sources.reason: Google Books exposes search snippets rather than a reusable open edition, and no open license was found.
sources.next_action: Locate a licensed edition or obtain permission from the author estate and publisher.

sources.title: Garhwali folk art and folk literature comparative study by Shanti Chaudhary (1994)
sources.content: Hindi research book with Garhwali folk-literature material from an Internet Archive/DLI scan
sources.reason: The PDF, OCR text, DjVu XML and metadata were archived; 298 OCR page records were extracted. Archive metadata supplies no open license or rights statement.
sources.next_action: Clean and language-segment locally while retaining provenance and the rights-pending label.

sources.title: Garhwali idioms and proverbs collection by Pushkar Singh Kandari
sources.content: Dictionary-scale idiom and proverb collection
sources.reason: Only cover and contents files are public and no open-content license is shown.
sources.next_action: Seek a licensed digital export.

sources.title: Himalayan Folklore by E. S. Oakley and Tara Dutt Gairola
sources.content: English translations of Kumaoni and Garhwali heroic ballads and folklore
sources.reason: Public domain in India; likely United States copyright through 2031 after restoration.
sources.next_action: Re-evaluate for international release in 2032 or obtain legal review.

sources.title: Sadei and Garhwali Kavitavali
sources.content: Early modern Garhwali poetry associated with Tara Dutt Gairola
sources.reason: Publication dates, contributor deaths, edition rights, scans, and United States restoration terms require item-level review.
sources.next_action: Locate authoritative first-edition scans and establish contributor-level rights.

sources.title: Garhwali, the historical periodical
sources.content: Garhwali-language and regional periodical published from 1905 into the mid-twentieth century
sources.reason: No complete issue archive with issue-level rights and stable scans was found.
sources.next_action: Search state, university, memorial, and national-library catalogues.

sources.title: StoryWeaver open stories
sources.content: CC BY 4.0 multilingual children's stories
sources.reason: The checked public source repository contained 18 language directories but no gbm or Garhwali directory.
sources.next_action: Recheck the live catalogue and ingest future Garhwali translations with attribution.

sources.title: Modern Garhwali plays and story collections named by UOU
sources.content: Bibliography and short educational excerpts covering Garhwali theatre, stories and novels
sources.reason: UOU terms do not establish redistribution rights for complete underlying modern works.
sources.next_action: Approach authors, estates, theatre groups, publishers, and UOU for licensed editions.

sources.title: Garhwali Folktales digitalization research chapter
sources.content: Current discussion and bibliography for Garhwali folklore digitization
sources.reason: Public PDF access did not establish an open-content license for training-data extraction.
sources.next_action: Use its bibliography for rights outreach and community collection planning.

sources.title: Kumauni Archives Garhwali-filtered catalogue
sources.content: Searchable non-profit catalogue with a Garhwali language filter and literature, ballad, folk-tale, flora, fauna and linguistic categories
sources.reason: The interface exposes a Garhwali-filtered cultural catalogue, but its terms prohibit copying/mirroring. Items also need language and rights assessment.
sources.next_action: Use for bibliographic discovery only; seek written permission or licensed exports before acquiring item text.

sources.title: Lucknow Digital Library Garhwali folk-literature holdings
sources.content: Digitized-book listing includes Garhwali folk-literature research
sources.reason: Search results establish a holding, not an open reuse license or a Garhwali-text payload.
sources.next_action: Open the item record, identify scan access and complete edition-level rights review.

sources.title: Nehru Memorial Museum and Library Garhwali periodical microfilm
sources.content: Catalogue reports Garhwali fortnightly microfilm holdings for 1916–1926, with gaps
sources.reason: The catalogue lists reels rather than openly downloadable issues.
sources.next_action: Request access and digitization metadata from the holding institution.

sources.title: UK Academe Garhwali bird dictionary pages
sources.content: Individual bird terms with Garhwali, Hindi and English examples
sources.reason: The site states all rights reserved; overlapping terms were already recorded from other sources.
sources.next_action: Request a licensed structured export and contributor provenance.

sources.title: Balakrishna D. Dhyani, Garhwali Muhavare Aur Kahavaten
sources.content: Garhwali idioms and proverbs, including Hindi and English explanations for comparison entries
sources.reason: The public page was archived and yielded 99 exact-unique Garhwali records; the page does not state an open-content license.
sources.next_action: Normalize spelling and have a native speaker review boundaries and meanings.

sources.title: Uttarakhand e-Magazine Blogger feed — tenth-wave candidate intake
sources.content: 6,844 Blogger feed entries scanned; 1,770 exact-new candidate page texts retained locally (6,755,681 source characters).
sources.reason: The public feed is robots-allowed, but public access is not an open reuse license. The title/URL filter can select Hindi, regional-history, mixed-language, or other non-Garhwali text. Automatic language tagging left these records low-confidence or scope-unverified.
sources.next_action: Keep provenance and full text in the local experimental layer; review language identity and item-level reuse terms before training promotion or public distribution.

sources.title: Uttarakhand Khabar Saar — two Garhwali-labelled short stories
sources.content: Two story pages: Jani Mayedi Tani Jayedi and Khuded Bhajed; 3,127 source characters retained locally.
sources.reason: The pages label the stories Garhwali, but no compatible open-content license was found. The text is not native-reviewed.
sources.next_action: Preserve the local experimental copies and source citations; request or verify reuse permission before redistribution.

sources.title: Garhwali Language Library 1.0.0 — pinned static text files
sources.content: 180 static word, phrase, proverb, and riddle rows; 180 distinct strings, 16 exact overlaps with the existing corpus, and 164 exact-new strings. Generated inflection outputs are not included.
sources.reason: Pinned commit 46564fab21299512c104e7b0cbf8bd3064285efd and source-file Git blob hashes are recorded. Repository declares MIT; language labels and gloss quality are upstream assertions and remain unreviewed.
sources.next_action: Keep all 180 rows provenance-linked in the experimental lexical layer; seek native review before recommending training.

sources.title: Jambu Garhwali reflex lexicon — revalidated for v0.2.1
sources.content: 763 source rows and 738 distinct forms. All 738 forms already exist in the pre-refresh corpus snapshot; the v0.2.1 refresh adds zero new rows from Jambu. The original intake had 28 exact overlaps with other sources and 710 forms novel relative to those other sources.
sources.reason: The pinned local HTML snapshot and row IDs are verified; source advertises CC BY 4.0. This is a lexical reflex list, not natural conversational prose, and remains unreviewed.
sources.next_action: Retain as a deduplicated source contribution; use its forms for lexical coverage and language-identification analyses, not as an incremental v2 source claim.

sources.title: LDC-IL Garhwali Parallel Text Corpus: Linguistic Features and Structures
sources.content: The official LDC-IL released-dataset catalogue explicitly lists a Garhwali parallel-text product. Its individual product details, sample, public payload, price, and redistribution license were not resolved in this pass.
sources.reason: Catalogue listing is not a downloadable corpus or an open license. LDC-IL's portal documents separate commercial and non-commercial undertakings and price per language component.
sources.next_action: Inspect the live Garhwali product record, request its sample and exact terms/price, and compare item-level text against all current corpus hashes before considering acquisition.

sources.title: LDC-IL Are Parallel Text Corpus: Linguistic Features and Structures
sources.content: The official product page describes English-linked material for 146 mother tongues, 5,332 sentences/phrases per language, and a single-language-component price. The available page does not establish whether the Garhwali component is included in this product or its exact access terms.
sources.reason: No Garhwali payload or open redistribution license was found. The source is a high-value acquisition lead, not data already in the project.
sources.next_action: Ask LDC-IL to confirm Garhwali coverage, item-level sample, price, and redistribution/model-training rights; deduplicate any authorized export against the project before ingestion.

sources.title: English–Garhwali SMT corpora described by Arushi Uniyal
sources.content: The 2019 article describes a 40,000-sentence Garhwali monolingual collection (magazine OCR, Bible excerpts, web blogs) and a 30,000-sentence English–Garhwali parallel corpus. Dr. Uniyal's HNBGU CV separately says 70,000 Garhwali sentences were digitized.
sources.reason: The cited research explains the corpus but does not expose the data or a reuse license. Likely source overlap with existing web, scripture, and magazine material is substantial; row-level source lineage is essential.
sources.next_action: Request the original dataset, alignment/provenance manifest, and redistribution/model-training permission from the researcher or university; run exact and fuzzy overlap checks before any promotion.

sources.title: Creative Uttarakhand Garhwali children's-song and folklore publications
sources.content: Catalogue lists Hem Pant's Ghuguti Basuti — Bhag 2 as Garhwali children's songs and Nyauli Sankalan as a cultural archive; digital books can be requested directly.
sources.reason: The listed works are not openly downloadable from the page and no dataset reuse license is stated.
sources.next_action: Request an authorized digital copy and explicit text-mining, model-training, and redistribution terms; preserve item and performer attribution.

sources.title: Hindwi Garhwali dictionary
sources.content: A public Garhwali dictionary with word meanings and usage information; no machine-readable open-license export was identified.
sources.reason: Public page access does not establish permission to scrape or redistribute the dictionary entries.
sources.next_action: Request a licensed export and source/contributor provenance from Rekhta Foundation.

sources.title: HimLingo Garhwali and Kumaoni dictionary
sources.content: Public dictionary/app pages describe Garhwali and Kumaoni vocabulary, phrases, and cultural content; the project reports restrictions on unauthorized scraping.
sources.reason: No licensed public machine-readable export was found, and the site's terms prohibit unauthorized scraping.
sources.next_action: Ask the maintainers for permission, a provenance-bearing export, and model-training and redistribution terms.

sources.title: Community-published Garhwali/Kumaoni dictionary app claim
sources.content: A developer post claims a 20,000-plus mixed Garhwali/Kumaoni vocabulary and literary material, without a downloadable corpus or source-level evidence.
sources.reason: The row count, language split, provenance, quality, and reuse license are unverified; the post does not publish the dataset.
sources.next_action: Request an export, per-record language/source/license metadata, and permission before evaluating or ingesting it.

sources.title: Endangered Languages Project Garhwali profile
sources.content: The profile search result exposes dialect and language-status bibliography, but no sentence or lexical payload; direct access timed out during the latest check.
sources.reason: The available result is linguistic metadata rather than reusable Garhwali language examples, and the page could not be fetched for detailed verification.
sources.next_action: Recheck the profile and use its references to find primary Garhwali material; do not count metadata as corpus text.

sources.title: LibreOffice Weblate Garhwali localization project
sources.content: The live localization project reports one string and 0% translated, with no useful Garhwali target text.
sources.reason: The available translation target is empty and contributes no language data.
sources.next_action: No ingestion unless the project later gains translated Garhwali strings.
